headline: Division's top scorers Southwest Baptist lose for the first time
dek: Southwest Baptist have scored more goals than any other programme in the division, and nobody had beaten them until Lincoln did. Lincoln are now the last unbeaten side in their conference; Texas A&M International's unbeaten start ended the same afternoon.
